title: Case I: The Key to Be Deleted is Present Only in the Leaf Node

blocks.content: Case I: The Key to Be Deleted is Present Only in the Leaf Node
If the key to be deleted is present only in the leaf node and not in the internal nodes, then we can simply delete it.
Here, we have two possible cases:

items: The node containing the key to be deleted has more than the minimum number of keys.
The node containing the key to be deleted has exactly the minimum number of keys to be deleted.
